items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: Scoop Kennedy? ... I don't know what these things are. These are some of that RTE, Sacred Breaker Corporation things. ... Scoop Kennedy. Who this lady is, I don't remember.

ctx.x: It was... We were just not equipped for it. We were not used to it. We nearly froze to death up there. And we were there... When we got on the train, we could have worn a T-shirt, and when we got off the train, we needed boots and everything. It was... It had come a blizzard that night up there. Scoop Kennedy?
Oh, yeah. I remember him. Mike Fritzel's has a beautiful restaurant there. It says in the Palmer House. Guys, week beginning December 30, 1950. Yeah, I don't know what this is.
